SN_lock_t.zh: 训练安全联锁启动：小船尚未取出。
SN_lock_t.en: TRAINING INTERLOCK: THE SMALL SHIP IS NOT OUT.

SV_backfeed_t.zh: 检测到备用供电路径：门锁备用电源。
SV_backfeed_t.en: BACKUP SUPPLY PATH DETECTED: THE LOCK'S OWN BACKUP.

SV_lock_t.zh: 训练安全联锁启动：门锁仍有供电。
SV_lock_t.en: TRAINING INTERLOCK: THE LOCK STILL HAS A SUPPLY.

text.zh: 开始训练之前，可以先看看这次要拆的船上都有哪些设备。如果遇到不认识的部件，可以随时按 I 打开图鉴，查看它的具体用途和拆卸方法。
text.en: BEFORE TRAINING STARTS, YOU CAN TAKE A LOOK AT WHAT EQUIPMENT THE SHIP YOU’LL BE TAKING APART HAS ON BOARD. IF YOU MEET A PART YOU DON’T RECOGNISE, PRESS I AT ANY TIME TO OPEN THE CODEX AND SEE WHAT IT IS FOR AND HOW TO REMOVE IT.

title.en: A SHIP IN A SHIP: OUT WHOLE

text.zh: 这次要把里面的小船完整拆出来，不过小船上还有一块电池。先找到电池 SK，把上面的 4 个连接点全部断开，确认电池已经断开以后，再处理固定小船的托架。（4）
text.en: THIS TIME YOU WILL TAKE THE SMALL BOAT INSIDE OUT WHOLE, BUT THE BOAT HAS A BATTERY OF ITS OWN. FIRST FIND BATTERY SK, DISCONNECT ALL 4 CONNECTION POINTS ON IT, AND ONLY AFTER CONFIRMING THE BATTERY IS DISCONNECTED DEAL WITH THE CRADLE HOLDING THE BOAT. (4)

text.zh: 接下来要把小船从托架上松开。先从船尾开始，找到 CL-1，把上面的 4 个锁定装置全部解除。船首的固定装置暂时留着，等船尾处理完以后再拆。（4）
text.en: NEXT THE BOAT MUST BE RELEASED FROM THE CRADLE. START AT THE STERN: FIND CL-1 AND RELEASE ALL 4 LOCKS ON IT. LEAVE THE BOW FASTENERS FOR NOW AND REMOVE THEM ONLY AFTER THE STERN IS DONE. (4)

text.zh: 船尾已经松开了，现在可以处理船首的托架锁 CL-2。把剩下的 4 个锁定装置全部解除，这样小船就可以从托架上取出来了。（4）
text.en: THE STERN IS LOOSE, SO NOW YOU CAN DEAL WITH BOW CRADLE LOCK CL-2. RELEASE ALL THE REMAINING 4 LOCKS, AND THE BOAT CAN COME OUT OF THE CRADLE. (4)

text.zh: 接下来找到船首的舱门 BOW，把 4 个锁定装置全部打开，给小船留出足够的出口。注意检查舱门有没有完全打开，避免拖船的时候发生碰撞。（4）
text.en: NEXT FIND BOW DOOR BOW AND OPEN ALL 4 LOCKS, LEAVING THE BOAT ENOUGH ROOM TO GET OUT. CHECK THAT THE DOOR IS FULLY OPEN SO NOTHING COLLIDES WHEN THE BOAT IS TOWED OUT. (4)

text.zh: 现在可以启动绞车 WINCH，把小船慢慢从船舱里面拖出来了。这次训练要求整艘小船完整回收，所以不要切割小船的外壳，尽量保持所有部件完好，成功拖出来就算完成训练。
text.en: NOW YOU CAN START WINCH AND SLOWLY HAUL THE BOAT OUT OF THE HOLD. THIS TRAINING REQUIRES THE WHOLE BOAT TO BE RECOVERED, SO DON’T CUT THE BOAT’S HULL; KEEP ALL ITS PARTS INTACT, AND SUCCESSFULLY HAULING IT OUT COMPLETES THE TRAINING.

title.zh: 库门：切断两路电源，再打开库门
title.en: THE VAULT: CUT BOTH POWER SUPPLIES, THEN OPEN THE VAULT DOOR

text.zh: 先检查一下门锁有没有通电。找到门锁电磁铁的验电点 E-L，测量一下当前的电压，确认门锁现在的供电情况。（1）
text.en: FIRST CHECK WHETHER THE DOOR LOCK HAS POWER. FIND LOCK SOLENOID TEST POINT E-L AND MEASURE THE CURRENT VOLTAGE TO CONFIRM THE LOCK’S POWER SUPPLY. (1)

text.zh: 找到主电源开关 K-B，把开关断开，先切断库门的主电源。（4）
text.en: FIND MAIN POWER SWITCH K-B AND OPEN IT, CUTTING THE VAULT DOOR’S MAIN POWER FIRST. (4)

text.zh: 现在回到验电点 E-L，再测量一次电压。奇怪，主电源已经断开了，门锁怎么还有电？看来还有别的地方在供电。
text.en: NOW GO BACK TO TEST POINT E-L AND MEASURE THE VOLTAGE AGAIN. STRANGE: THE MAIN POWER IS ALREADY OFF, SO WHY DOES THE LOCK STILL HAVE POWER? SOMETHING ELSE MUST BE SUPPLYING IT.

text.zh: 原来是备用电源还在给门锁供电。找到门锁备用电源开关 K-LB，把它也断开，这样才能把两路电源全部切断。（4）
text.en: IT TURNS OUT THE BACKUP POWER IS STILL FEEDING THE DOOR LOCK. FIND LOCK BACKUP POWER SWITCH K-LB AND OPEN IT TOO, SO THAT BOTH POWER SUPPLIES ARE CUT. (4)

text.zh: 再去测量一次 E-L，确认电压已经降到 0 V。只有确认门锁完全断电以后，才能继续操作。
text.en: MEASURE E-L ONCE MORE AND CONFIRM THE VOLTAGE HAS DROPPED TO 0 V. ONLY WHEN YOU HAVE CONFIRMED THE LOCK IS COMPLETELY DEAD CAN YOU CONTINUE.

text.zh: 现在两路电源都已经断开，可以操作机械释放杆了。找到 MR-1，把释放杆扳下来，解除库门的锁定。（4）
text.en: BOTH POWER SUPPLIES ARE NOW CUT, SO YOU CAN OPERATE THE MECHANICAL RELEASE LEVER. FIND MR-1 AND PULL THE LEVER DOWN TO UNLOCK THE VAULT DOOR. (4)

text.zh: 门锁已经解除，现在可以直接打开库门 VD-1。这道门可以手动打开，不需要重新接通电源。（4）
text.en: THE LOCK IS RELEASED, SO NOW YOU CAN OPEN VAULT DOOR VD-1 DIRECTLY. THIS DOOR CAN BE OPENED BY HAND, WITHOUT RECONNECTING POWER. (4)

text.zh: 进入库房以后，找到保管箱 SDB-1，把固定保管箱的 4 个连接件全部拆下来。拆卸的时候小心一点，尽量保留整个箱体。（4）
text.en: ONCE INSIDE THE VAULT, FIND DEPOSIT BOXES SDB-1 AND REMOVE ALL 4 CONNECTORS HOLDING THEM IN PLACE. BE CAREFUL WHILE REMOVING THEM AND KEEP THE WHOLE BOX INTACT AS YOU CAN. (4)

text.zh: 保管箱拆下来以后，把它完整运送到设备回收口就可以了。记得检查一下箱体有没有损坏，完整回收才能拿到应有的回收收益。
text.en: ONCE THE DEPOSIT BOXES ARE OFF, JUST DELIVER THEM WHOLE TO THE EQUIPMENT MOUTH. REMEMBER TO CHECK THE BOXES FOR DAMAGE, BECAUSE ONLY A WHOLE RECOVERY EARNS THE PROPER RECOVERY PAYOUT.
